I know gifting is easier when exchanges are simple. If the item is eligible, they can start an exchange here: https://kutfromthekloth.loopreturns.com/#/

Eligible items can be exchanged within 30 days of the order date. Items need to be unwashed, unworn, and have the original tags attached. Final Sale items are not eligible.

Once the exchange is started in the portal, a prepaid return label is sent by email. It is important to use that label and make sure FedEx scans it so the return can be tracked and processed. Returns are generally processed within 3 to 5 business days after the Returns Department receives them.

For return options, an e-gift card waives the $12.95 return processing fee, a refund to the original payment includes the $12.95 return processing fee, and an instant exchange places a temporary hold for the new item and adjusts once the return is received.
